E6.union: concatenate both K=5 supports with one-half of each native probability
E6.compression: exact target-blind probability-weighted K-medoids from 10 atoms to 5 atoms; lexicographic tie break; assign mass to nearest retained medoid
E6.aligned_average: ordinary minimum-cost bijection followed by equal support and probability averaging

E7.shared_encoder_dual_decoder: one native ASCENT history encoder evaluated once and two independent K=5 physical decoder branches, trained jointly as a K=10 finite measure

E8.mabpt_update_accounting: 20 epochs source B0 at batch256 plus 20 epochs target geometry at batch256 plus 20 epochs Energy head at batch1024
E8.equal_update_control: frozen seed42 B0 epoch20 plus seed7 B0 epoch25
E8.equality: for each fold, 40*ceil(N/256)+20*ceil(N/1024) equals 45*ceil(N/256) because each registered N gives ceil(N/1024)=ceil(N/256)/4
E8.inference: two ASCENT forwards and an equal-weight K=10 mixture

reporting: Report every registered arm on both folds, including negative results. E6-E8 are secondary mechanism controls and do not convert retrospective folds into confirmatory evidence.
